builds.hypothesis:
Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining [175 / 350 / 525] Health and [50] Attack Range for the next [12] seconds.

Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for [2 / 3 / 4] seconds and dealing [300 / 500 / 700 + (1.25) × AP + (2.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are Slowed by [50]%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer [300 / 500 / 700 + (1.25) × AP + (2.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.
Bloodthirster/Infinity Edge/Eclipse provide high AD; Grudge supplies armor penetration; Profane/Youmuu supply AD and lethality. Infinity Edge crit is not assumed to multiply this spell. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

builds.goal: Explore a large marked Frenzied Maul second cast number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 marked W uses (105 + 1.1 total AD + 0.06 bonus HP) times (1.5 + 0.0025 bonus AD). Bonus AD therefore increases both the inner hit and the outer multiplier. Bloodmail makes HP valuable on both sides through its AD conversion; Sterak and Bloodthirster add AD, while Serylda tests whether mitigation matters more than one more HP slot.

builds.goal: Investigate high three seconds of fully stacked passive lightning on one champion output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each passive stack grants 5% + 0.04% per AP attack speed, up to five stacks. At five stacks, each qualifying lightning packet uses a level-breakpoint base + 0.45 AP + 0.2 bonus AD magic. AP can raise both per-hit damage and attack frequency; actual AS cap, animation cadence and proc rules must still be measured.
